_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the loopback ports the first-party apps' vite dev servers bind to. BOTH languages derive from this file: Rust embeds it at compile time (`apps-rust/src/dev_seed.rs`, which seeds the debug-only `<app>-dev` rows whose launch URLs name these ports, for the apps that have one; gatekeeper-rust's `seed_dev_app_clients`, for their clients' redirects; and `host-app/src-tauri/build.rs`, for the launcher's dev address), and on the TypeScript side exactly one reader parses it — `devAppServer(id)` in the root `vite.config.base.ts`, which each app's `vite.config.ts` spreads into `server` (`preview`, for `ohif-viewer`) to set the port with `strictPort`, so a taken port fails loudly instead of drifting off the row's value. Add a TS reader here and you have added a second source; call the helper instead. Keys are the dev app ids: every other key must map to a port number, and `_comment` is the only non-port key. Change a value here and both sides follow.
